attempts.text: {"rows": [{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "The request says \"`PUT /tickets/:id/assignee` with a JSON body `{\"assignee\": \"<agent>\"}`\" and \"a ticket must match every filter given\"."}, {"n": 2, "label": "beyond", "why": "The request asks only that \"The agent a ticket is assigned to is notified\", so a new outbox store and background worker is extra infrastructure for a small dependency-free service."}, {"n": 3, "label": "implied", "why": "\"Every ticket shows its `assignee`\" needs the assignee persisted, and \"Everything the service already does keeps working\" needs existing data files to stay readable."}, {"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "Assignment and the rule that \"Assigning a ticket to the agent it already has changes nothing\" need consistent ordering of store changes, and reusing the existing synchronous store gives that without anything new."}, {"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "The request says \"an agent is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters\" and \"Only open and in-progress tickets can be assigned or unassigned\", which this validation enforces."}, {"n": 6, "label": "beyond", "why": "An audit trail of changes and retained outbox state are not needed by any requested outcome; the request asks only for assignment, notification, filtering and listing."}]}

labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "`PUT /tickets/:id/assignee` with a JSON body `{"assignee": "<agent>"}`" and "a ticket must match every filter given".

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: The request asks only that "The agent a ticket is assigned to is notified", so a new outbox store and background worker is extra infrastructure for a small dependency-free service.

labels.label: implied
labels.why: "Every ticket shows its `assignee`" needs the assignee persisted, and "Everything the service already does keeps working" needs existing data files to stay readable.

labels.label: implied
labels.why: Assignment and the rule that "Assigning a ticket to the agent it already has changes nothing" need consistent ordering of store changes, and reusing the existing synchronous store gives that without anything new.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "an agent is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters" and "Only open and in-progress tickets can be assigned or unassigned", which this validation enforces.

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: An audit trail of changes and retained outbox state are not needed by any requested outcome; the request asks only for assignment, notification, filtering and listing.
